events.body:
Title: [Functional/Onboarding] No path exists to create a hosted repository without desktop app or external provider

Environment: Web App + Desktop App (Windows)

Steps to Reproduce:

As a new user with no GitHub/GitLab/Codeberg account and no ForkMesh desktop node installed, attempt to create a new repository from the web app

Expected Result: A way to create and host a small repository directly through ForkMesh, without requiring desktop installation or an external provider.

Actual Result: No such path exists — repo creation from the web requires either the desktop node running locally, or importing from GitHub/GitLab/Codeberg (which itself doesn't complete real mirroring, per earlier reports).

Suggested fix: Offer temporary/lightweight hosting by ForkMesh itself for new repos, with an option to migrate to a self-hosted mirror later — preserves the decentralization goal while removing the day-one onboarding wall.
